name: Docker
source: curated for hotdoc M2 (common ops only, no Compose-Plugin or BuildKit-only commands)

entries.description: List currently running containers. Add -a to include stopped ones.

entries.description: Create and start a new container from an image. Common flags: -d (detached), -p host:container (port), --name <name>, -it (interactive tty).

examples.description: Run nginx in the background on port 8080

entries.description: Execute a command in a running container. Use `bash` or `sh` for an interactive shell.

entries.title: Show last N lines of container logs
entries.description: Print the last N log lines without following.

entries.description: Send SIGTERM then SIGKILL after a grace period. Use docker kill to skip the grace period.

entries.title: Start an existing stopped container
entries.description: Start a previously created or stopped container.

entries.description: Remove a stopped container. Use -f to force-remove a running one.

entries.title: Remove a local image
entries.description: Remove an image from local cache. Use -f to force.

entries.title: Pull an image from a registry
entries.description: Download an image from a registry (Docker Hub by default).

entries.description: Build an image from a Dockerfile in <path> and tag it. <path> is usually `.`.

entries.description: Free disk by removing all unused Docker objects. Add --volumes to also remove unused volumes.

entries.description: Return JSON with full configuration and runtime state of a container, image, or volume.
